links.outcome: GPT-4o error-detection recall/accuracy/F1 under different prompt strategies (zero-shot vs meta-prompt)
links.effect: Meta prompt improved recall (43.33% vs 52.67%, P = 0.022), accuracy (39.95% vs 68.75%, P < 0.001), and F1 (0.42 vs 0.60, P < 0.001) versus zero-shot and other prompt strategies.
links.quote: GPT-4o with the meta prompt demonstrated improvements in recall (43.33% vs. 52.67%, P = 0.022), accuracy (39.95% vs. 68.75%, P < 0.001), and F1 score (0.42 vs. 0.60, P < 0.001) compared to the zero-shot prompt and other prompt strategies.
